description: Necklace (a workflow of tested agents: 3 verified pearls): Where the address is, that country's public holidays in the year asked, and the local time there, in one answer: the place is resolved first, then the next steps read it. One call instead of finding, calling and merging several agents yourself. Scope: National public holidays only: regional (state or province) holidays are not included. A place in an overseas territory is answered with the holidays of the country it belongs to, which can differ from the territory's own. Example arguments: {"address":"Tokyo Tower, Minato, Tokyo, Japan","year":2026}. Paid: 0.030000 USDC per run (3 steps × 0.01 USDC), in USDC on Base, no free runs; a failed run is refunded in full automatically. The quoted amount can be up to 0.000999 USDC above the listed price; those digits identify your payment. Send payment {"payer_address": "0x..."} (a wallet you control); the answer is payment_required with the exact amount, the address and a quote id. Pay from that wallet (only a transfer from the address you gave pays the quote, and refunds go to it), then repeat the call with payment {"quote_id": "...", "tx_hash": "0x..."}. Refund window, fees and replays: necklace_details or /agents/earn. Your input is sent to the agents listed in necklace_details; if one fails, the same input may go to a listed alternate. No credentials or payments are sent to these agents. Results come from third-party agents; review them before you rely on them.

detail.description: full (default) or brief: the same facts, values and links in fewer tokens.

payment.description: First call: payer_address of a wallet you control; second call: quote_id and the tx_hash of your USDC transfer on Base.

payer_address.description: The EVM address that will send the USDC. Required to get a quote.
